# costgraph_focus_push_integration (Resource)

Register a provider account for FOCUS billing records sent to CostGraph. The resource returns the connection ID used for ingestion. Creating it does not send records or create an API key. Requires an API key belonging to an organization owner, admin, or billing admin with access to the tenant. Destroying the resource disconnects the account and removes its ingested data from cost views.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "costgraph_focus_push_integration" "billing" {
  provider_name       = "aws"
  provider_account_id = "123456789012"
  display_name        = "Production billing"
}

output "ingestion_connection_id" {
  value = costgraph_focus_push_integration.billing.connection_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_account_id` (String) Billing account identifier present in the FOCUS records. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `provider_name` (String) Canonical provider name, such as aws, gcp, or azure, using lowercase letters and digits. Changing it replaces the connection.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in CostGraph. Defaults to the billing account identifier when created. Updates rename the connection in place. Omitting this after creation keeps the existing name.
- `tenant_id` (String) Lowercase tenant UUID. Defaults to the tenant of the API key. The key must have access to this tenant. Changing it replaces the connection.

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) Public connection ID beginning with fpc_ used when sending FOCUS records. Use id for import.
- `id` (String) Connection UUID used for management and import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import costgraph_focus_push_integration.billing 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
